asset_assessments.title: University of Chicago Monogenic Diabetes Registry
asset_assessments.description: Longitudinal research registry for families with known or suspected monogenic diabetes; public pages mention GATA6.
asset_assessments.owner: University of Chicago Monogenic Diabetes program
asset_assessments.access: Public program pages; participation/data access require contacting the program. Atlas sends nothing automatically.
asset_assessments.relevance_to_journey: Best verified research-community asset while a dedicated GATA6 foundation remains missing.

may_be_reusable: Public education pages on GATA6-associated malformations
needs_expert_review: Current GATA6 enrollment and data-access pathway
Whether cardiac-only GATA6 cases are in scope
comparison.validation_question: Can the registry answer a genotype-aware GATA6 natural-history question under its current consent model?
